description: For each batting hand, count the manager award records won by people with that hand, and give each hand's share of all matched award records.

a.request: Using manager award records matched to the `player` table by `player_id` (dropping awards with no matching player), group by the winner's batting hand (`bats`), with a blank or missing hand as its own group. For each hand, show the batting hand, the number of manager award records won by people with that hand, and that number's share of the total award records across all hands, with no rounding.
a.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')

b.request: For each `player.bats` value, with blank or missing values in one separate group, count matching `manager_award` records and divide that count by the total number of `manager_award` records matching a `player`, without rounding
b.sql: WITH matched_total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id) SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(p.bats, '')) = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.bats END AS bats, COUNT(ma.player_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(matched_total.n, 0) AS proportion FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id CROSS JOIN matched_total GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(p.bats, '')) = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.bats END, matched_total.n

c.request: How do manager award winners break down by batting hand (`bats`)? Use only awards that match a record in `player`, and treat a blank or missing hand as its own group. For each hand, show the hand, how many manager award winners it has, and that figure's share of the overall total (no rounding). For each batting hand, count the manager award records won by people with that hand, and give each hand's share of all matched award records.
c.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS award_wins FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown')) SELECT hand, award_wins, award_wins * 1.0 / SUM(award_wins) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY hand;

d.request: For each batting hand (`bats`), how many manager award records were won by people with that hand, and what share of all manager award records matched to a `player` record does each group represent? Include blank or missing hands as their own group, and do not round the shares.
d.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.bats END AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.bats END
